steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant from the sample.

steps.title: Sonicate sample
steps.instruction: Sonicate on ice (0 °C) for 2 min using 10 s on/off cycles at 30 %, 60 % and 80 % amplitudes with a QSonica Q800R1 sonicator (discontinued).

steps.title: Cryomill disruption
steps.instruction: Disrupt the sample in a CryoMill (Retsch GmbH, model 20.749.0001) for 3 min at 30 Hz (3 cycles).

steps.title: Add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL lysis buffer containing 8 M urea (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #57-13-6) and 2 % (v/v) SDS (Bio‑Rad, Cat #1610301) to 250 mg homogenate.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate at 1000 rpm, 25 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Aliquot supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect 200 µL of supernatant.

steps.title: Add methanol
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL methanol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #M3641).

steps.title: Add chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform (contributed by users).

steps.title: Ultrasonic bath
steps.instruction: Place the mixture in an ultrasonic bath (PCB‑GALS PSB‑1335‑03) at 50 Hz for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Add DTT
steps.instruction: Add dithiothreitol (neoFroxx, Cat #3483-12-3) to a final concentration of 10 mM, then incubate at 500 rpm, 56 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add IAA
steps.instruction: Add iodoacetamide (single‑use vial 56 mg, Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #A3221, CAS 144‑48‑9) to a final concentration of 20 mM and incubate in the dark for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add trypsin
steps.instruction: Add sequencing‑grade modified trypsin (Promega, Cat #V5111) at 1/75 % (w/w) and incubate at 500 rpm, 37 °C overnight (≈19 hours).

steps.title: Add DTT (ultrasonic)
steps.instruction: Add DTT (neoFroxx, Cat #3483-12-3) to 10 mM and incubate in an ultrasonic bath at 56 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add IAA (ultrasonic)
steps.instruction: Add IAA to 20 mM and incubate in the dark for 3 minutes 20 seconds in an ultrasonic bath at 40 °C.

steps.title: Add trypsin (ultrasonic)
steps.instruction: Add trypsin at 1/75 % (w/w) and incubate in an ultrasonic bath at 50 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Add DTT (short)
steps.instruction: Add DTT to 10 mM and incubate at 500 rpm, 56 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add IAA (short)
steps.instruction: Add IAA to 20 mM and incubate in the dark for 3 minutes 20 seconds.

steps.title: Add trypsin (50 °C)
steps.instruction: Add trypsin at 1/75 % (w/w) and incubate at 500 rpm, 50 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Add DTT (20 min)
steps.instruction: Add DTT to 10 mM and incubate at 500 rpm, 56 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add IAA (30 min)
steps.instruction: Add IAA to 20 mM and incubate in the dark for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add DTT (1 min)
steps.instruction: Add DTT to 10 mM and incubate at 500 rpm, 56 °C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Add IAA (microwave)
steps.instruction: Add IAA to 20 mM and incubate in the dark for 2 minutes in a microwave oven (Samsung me83xr/bwt) at 100 W, 25 °C.

steps.title: Add trypsin (37 °C)
steps.instruction: Add trypsin at 1/75 % (w/w) and incubate at 500 rpm, 37 °C for 1 hour (protocol 4_37).

steps.title: Add trypsin (50 °C)
steps.instruction: Incubate at 500 rpm, 50 °C for 1 hour (protocol 4_50).

steps.title: Add water
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Milli‑Q water (contributed by users).

steps.title: Add methanol
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL methanol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #M3641).

steps.title: Dissolve pellet
steps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet in 200 µL 2 M urea (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #57-13-6).

steps.title: Add trypsin (microwave)
steps.instruction: Add trypsin at 1/75 % (w/w) and incubate in a microwave oven (Samsung me83xr/bwt) at 100 W for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add TFA
steps.instruction: Add trifluoroacetic acid (TFA, contributed by users) to a final concentration of 1 % (v/v).
